effectSummary.ko: 교차 쇠뇌의 교차 사격이 첫 적을 관통하여 같은 사선의 적 한 명을 사격 피해의 50%로 더 맞힙니다. 최대 2명, 실제 사거리·벽 충돌을 유지하며 추가 발동을 재생산하지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Crossfire Ballista crossfire shots pierce the first enemy to hit one additional enemy on the same firing line at 50% shot damage, up to 2. Preserve actual range and wall collision; secondary shots trigger no further procs.

productionConcept: An enduring distance-support emblem: a miniature stout iron ballista head and a weathered leather boot separated by one broad pale trail wedge. The two substantial forms remain within a compact diagonal composition, symbolizing strength from maintaining distance, no floor.
prompt: Create one square HELLSCRIPT dark fantasy RPG skill icon for AP17 (Ranger). Main subject: one powerful green-gold ballista bolt piercing two small iron target plates aligned in a diagonal firing line, a bold secondary crossing ray indicates crossfire, clearly two punctured targets. Painterly premium game ability icon, strong sculpted silhouette, weathered iron and focused luminous magical accent, restrained dark desaturated colors, dramatic readable highlights. Composition must remain unmistakable at 64 by 64 pixels. One isolated centered icon subject fills about 85 percent of the square; no decorative circular medallion, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no additional unrelated weapons. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha. All surrounding space and internal empty spaces fully transparent; no scenery, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no frame, no unwanted shadow. Keep wispy effects minimal and clean at small size. Do not add an opaque background.

reuse.reason: No suitable per-ID native-alpha 1024px source found; existing shared SkillAtlas is not a per-ID master.

notes.ko: 새 전투 컨셉의 주체와 방향이 64px에서도 구별됩니다. 밝은·어두운 배경에서 투명 여백과 내부 빈 공간, 주요 실루엣을 확인했습니다.
notes.en: The new mechanic silhouette and direction remain distinct at 64px. Reviewed transparent margins, internal gaps and primary shapes on light and dark backgrounds.
